notablePrerequisites:
Yidaro has been cycled at least three times previously.
You control a Mountain.
description:
Cycle Yidaro by paying {1}{R}, drawing a card and putting Yidaro onto the battlefield from your graveyard.
Yidaro enters, triggering Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least eight {R}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Alena from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Alena for {4}{R}.
Alena enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
